thread:
Marie (CS): Heads-up — Violet Labs pilot wrap. Capturing their feature asks / pain points before renewal sync. Paste from the call below, please react with :+1: if you can take an item or comment ETA.
Violet Labs (customer): Quick list from our side:
1) per-route cost breakdown in console (we need to attribute spend to product lines)
2) sticky cache for embeddings so search results don't go stale after reindexes
3) ability to pin model family per-route to avoid accidental rollouts
4) lower-precision "quantized" option that hits ~100ms SLO for short queries
5) more step-by-step Private deploy networking docs (we tripped on VPC NAT + DNS)
6) per-route rate-limits so internal teammates can't blow out quotas
Diego (PM): Copy — can someone summarize severity / renewal impact?
Marie (CS): Their note: #1 and #4 are deal-deciding. I'd call #1 and #4 High, #2 and #5 Medium, #3 and #6 Low.
Priya (Eng): I can look at #4 (quantized path). Quick q for Violet Labs — what's avg seq length?
Violet Labs (customer): Avg ~512, bursts to ~2000 on ingestion jobs.
Omar (ProductOps): I'll take #1 (per-route cost). Need a 30d usage export from their account — @Violet Labs can you drop CSV link?
Violet Labs (customer): Uploading now: https://vlabs.s3/private/violet-usage-30d.csv (internal link). We want charts grouped by "route" + model variant.
Diego (PM): Triage suggestion: quick-win = #6 (rate-limits) as a console toggle in 2 sprints; spike #4 for perf; #2 sticky embed cache is medium-term.
Priya (Eng): Agree. I'll spike quantized option this week — estimate 5 work days to prototype and measure perf at 512/2k seqs.
Marie (CS): Action items: @Omar own #1, @Priya do the spike for #4, @Diego scope roadmap priority, I'll prepare a one-pager for their renewal CSM.
Diego (PM): Can we capture a short customer quote about impact for the one-pager?
Violet Labs (customer): Quote: 'Per-route cost visibility + a quantized low-latency option are blockers for us to scale beyond trial.' You can use that.
Priya (Eng): Note: #3 (model pinning) might be doable via routing rules — low effort. If helpful I can prototype a config sample: `route_overrides:\n  - route: ingest\n    pinned_model: redwood-v2-small`
Marie (CS): :thumbsup: Adding to CS tracker doc: https://doc.redwood/internal/cs/violet-pilot (internal).
PulseBot: Reminder — triage meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda: Violet Labs items.
Diego (PM): Thanks all. If other Product/Eng folks can jump on the spike or take ownership, please react with :rocket:.
